query: Miniprotein binders against the campaign-one target NY-ESO-1 157-165 (SLLMWITQC) presented on HLA-A*02:01, from the campaign's own case record.
_swap: The case record and the design spec now describe the same peptide (SLLMWITQC). The record is unsigned, so the design hold still refuses a real design run; signing it is clinical work, not a code edit. The hold also stays in force for the human-reference gate, the margin and the structural margin threshold, independently of the signature.

curation._ipsae_veto_floor: UNSET, deliberately. bindi.ipsae_veto reads policy.curation.ipsae_veto_floor as the floor below which the ipSAE VETO-ONLY filter removes a design. With no floor the filter is inert: it removes nothing and asserts nothing. No default exists in code, because a number there would be a threshold in all but name. A floor is a campaign decision; even once set, the filter may only refuse a design and can never pass, rank, promote or certify one, and it never clears the margin stage.

_needs_mathew: Case record fixtures/immunology_case_NYESO1_A0201.json is UNSIGNED: a clinical signature cannot be supplied by an agent. Its signature.placeholder_reason lists the five things signing it would attest to.

Consent fields on that record are false because there is no individual patient (campaign one targets a published shared antigen). Whether a demonstration campaign needs a consent record at all is a BIO Physician determination.
The ten decoy peptides of the specificity panel are described in CASE.md but not enumerated anywhere in this repository, and are not invented here.

Negative-design panel: the TARGETED panel is now wired in, but residue-level BIO Physician sign-off is still outstanding and the helix endpoints are the source document's judgement, not verified fact.
num_designs is the API minimum (10), not a campaign size. 300 designs prices at $15.0000, the whole standing APPR cap.
Whether to crop the target construct to get under the 512-residue pricing tier is NOT an engineering decision and has not been made: see the open question in docs/PROPOSAL-ipsae-structural-margin.md.
